correctness.rationale: The proof is exact. Since \(m\mid p+1\), \(\mathbb F_p^\times\subset H\). After decomposing \(H\) into \(\mathbb F_p^\times\)-lines, each line contributes \(p-1\) if it is the unique trace-zero line and \(-1\) otherwise. The induced quotient character has total sum zero, so an entry is zero unless its product orbit contains the trace-zero line, in which case it equals \(p\chi(t_0)\). This produces a monomial matrix and proves all stated counts.

This is a reusable mechanism rather than a routine finite extension.
